source_refs.note: Topic 5.6.2 (PDF 149, printed 146). Long question 3 is answered; pie charts and heatmaps are named in the chapter but not explained, and their one-line uses are general knowledge, flagged.

items: Enter your data, for example months in one column and sales in another.
Select the data by clicking and dragging over the cells.
Choose a chart type from the Insert tab (bar chart, line graph and so on).
Customize the chart: add labels, such as months on the x-axis and sales figures on the y-axis, to make it easier to interpret.
Understand what it shows: bar charts compare categories such as monthly sales; line graphs show trends over time.
